I grind my own coffee so it is important to note a couple things. The screen on the included basket will stop the majority of the silt from getting to your cup but it cannot stop everything. The best way to prevent this is to use a paper filter to keep the coffee dust in the basket and out of your coffee cup. It is also important to be careful how fine a grind you use as coffee ground too fine will clog the screen and/or the paper filter.

Slightly off topic: If you are planning to get a coffee grinder so you have total control when and how your coffee is ground, get a conical grinder so your grind is consistent. The "twirling blades of death" style of grinder really doesn't provide the proper grind consistency.
